Enabled.Name: Connect to MCP server
Enabled.Hint: Connect this browser to the foundry-mcp server. Only GM users connect.

ServerUrl.Name: MCP server address
ServerUrl.Hint: WebSocket address of the foundry-mcp server running on this computer.

Token.Name: Token
Token.Hint: The same secret you set as FOUNDRY_MCP_TOKEN for the foundry-mcp server.

FOUNDRY_MCP.Connected: Foundry MCP: connected to the MCP server.
FOUNDRY_MCP.NoToken: Foundry MCP: set the token in the module settings to connect.
FOUNDRY_MCP.BadToken: Foundry MCP: the MCP server rejected the token. Check the module settings.
FOUNDRY_MCP.Replaced: Foundry MCP: another browser tab took over the MCP connection.
